comment: * Constants and utility methods for refresh rate settings.

methods.name: public static float findHighestRefreshRateForDefaultDisplay(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Find the highest refresh rate among all the modes of the default display.
     *
     * This method will acquire DisplayManager.mLock, so calling it while holding other locks
     * should be done with care.
     * @param context The context
     * @return The highest refresh rate

methods.name: public static float findHighestRefreshRateAmongAllDisplays(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Find the highest refresh rate among all the modes of all the displays.
     *
     * This method will acquire DisplayManager.mLock, so calling it while holding other locks
     * should be done with care.
     * @param context The context
     * @return The highest refresh rate
